answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered pension fund trustee record with pensions regulator standing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 754 pays 10556 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the haven here is verification, the opal of cost is what stops the farm, and the relic of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
